title: ArxaleousPack: Vanilla Done Right
description:
ArxaleousPack: Vanilla Done Right
is a refined modpack that expands Minecraft with new biomes, structures, and subtle content additions—without breaking the game's original feel. It’s a fresh yet familiar adventure, perfect for players who want more depth.
body:
🧱 Modpack Overview
This is a heavily visual, immersive, and performance-optimized modpack for Minecraft 1.21.4. It blends realistic animations, enhanced shaders, optimized performance, revamped mobs, and immersive worldbuilding, making Minecraft feel alive and modern while staying true to its sandbox roots. Ideal for players who want atmosphere and performance without sacrificing the base game.

>  # MODS
> 
> ## 🧠CORE LIBRARIES & APIs
> 
>  Fabric API / Language Kotlin / Architectury API / Puzzles Lib / Forge Config API Port / oωo (owo-lib) / JamLib / OctoLib / Fzzy Config / CICADA / Iceberg / CreativeCore – Provide foundational code or multi-platform support.
> 
> Cloth Config – Offers mod config GUIs.
> 
> Malilib – Required by Litematica and similar mods.
>  
> Bookshelf Inspector / Model Gap Fix / GlitchCore / Quad / Mod Menu – Minor APIs or utilities.
> 
> 
> 
> ## ⚙️ PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION
> 
> Improve FPS and resource usage:
> 
> Lithium – Physics and entity optimization.
> 
> FerriteCore – Reduces RAM usage via memory optimizations.
> 
> ModernFix – Major overall performance boost.
> 
> ImmediatelyFast – Speeds up rendering pipeline.
> 
> Entity Culling – Hides unseen entities.
> 
> More Culling / BadOptimizations / Euphoria Patches – Fine-tune entity/rendering performance.
> 
> Continuity – Connects textures seamlessly.
> 
> Cubes Without Borders – Renders chunks more smoothly.
> 
> 
> 
> 
> ## 🎮 UI / HUD ENHANCEMENTS
> Enchance or overhaul the Minecraft interface:
> 
> BetterF3 / Better Statistics Screen / Better Ping Display / Better Advancements / Advancement Plaques – Major visual and data improvements to overlays and stat/advancement menus.
> 
> OptiGUI – UI tweaks, like compact options.
> 
> Item Highlighter / Item Borders / Legendary Tooltips – Emphasize or beautify tooltips and highlights.
> 
> Immersive UI – Makes HUD transitions smooth.
> 
> Scribble – Adds in-game note-taking.
> 
> Music Notification – Notifies of music change.
> 
> 
> ## 🔧 QUALITY OF LIFE (QoL)
> Improve player experience without breaking balance:
> 
> RightClickHarvest – Right-click crops to harvest/replant.
> 
> Carry On – Move chests/mobs with your hands.
> 
> InvMove – Move while GUI is open.
> 
> Mouse Tweaks – Mass item movement.
> 
> AppleSkin – Shows food saturation in HUD.
> 
> Clumps – Combine XP orbs.
> 
> Cherished Worlds – Mark and favorite saves.
> 
> Armor Stand Arms / Elytra Trims / Armor Trim Fix / Enchanted Bookshelves / More Chiseled Bookshelf Variants – Decor and display enhancements.
> 
> 
> ## 🚀 GAMEPLAY FEATURES
> These mods add new mechanics, tweaks, or changes:
> 
> Better Than Mending – Replaces mending with balanced alternatives.
>  
> Do a Barrel Roll – Fun dodge mechanic.
>  
> Freecam – Detach camera for scouting.
>  
> Crawl – Adds crawling without elytra.
>  
> Elytra Physics – Adds glider-like physics.
>  
> Hold My Items – Prevents inventory loss on death.
> 
> Easy Shulker Boxes / Shulker Box Tooltip – Inventory enhancements.
> 
> Horse Buff / Horse Expert – Improves horse mechanics.
> 
> Cool Rain / Crops Love Rain – Rain-based effects on crops and ambiance.
> 
> Effectual / Particular / Particle Effects / Particle Rain – New particle systems and magic-like visuals.
> 
> 
> ## 🌎 WORLD GENERATION & STRUCTURES
> Mods that change terrain, biomes, or add new features:
> 
> Biomes O' Plenty – Adds tons of new biomes.
> 
> Serene Seasons – Seasonal cycles.
> 
> Dungeons and Taverns / qraftyfied: STRUCTURES – Procedural structures and lore locations.
> 
> Cave Dust / Lithostitched – Enhance cave biomes and underground visuals.
> 
> Glowing Torchflower / Mo Glass – Block variants and visual polish.
> 
> 
> ## 🔉 SOUND AND IMMERSION
> Mods that enhance audio and visual atmosphere:
> 
> AmbientSounds / Presence Footsteps – Rich ambient audio and realistic footsteps.
> 
> Falling Leaves / Chimes / Fog / Lighty / Flashback / Panorama – Immersive environmental effects.
> 
> 
> ## 📷 RECORDING & RENDERING
> ReplayMod – Create cinematic replays.
>  
> Iris Shaders – Shader support compatible with Sodium.
> 
> 
> ## 🐝 MISC & FUN
> oSzoukaua's Bee Small – Makes bees tiny.
> 
> Panorama – Changes title screen panorama.
> 
> No Resource Pack Warnings – Silences RP warning messages.
> 
> 
> ## ❓ FILES TO IGNORE
> desktop.ini – A Windows file, not a mod.
> 
> Unnamed mods (e.g., "Detail Armor Bar") – You may need to verify their file names or configs.
> 
> 

# RESOURCE PACKS

> ## 🌟 HD Textures & Models
> Faithful 64x, Fancy Crops, Actually 3D Stuff, Animated Items, 3D Tools & Utils
> 
> These increase VRAM usage significantly — up to 2–4x over vanilla.
> 
> ## 🎥 Full Animations & Emissive Elements
> Fresh Animations, Animated Totem, AL's Revamped Mobs, DetailedAnimationsTester
> 
> Heavily GPU-driven when combined with shaders and modded entities.
> 
> ## ✨ Shader-Paired Visuals
> Pale Garden Panorama with Shaders
> 
> Dramatic Skys, Better Lanterns, Motschen’s Leaves
> 
> These all assume Iris + high shader settings (e.g., Complementary, BSL, or Nostalgia).
> 
> ## 💡 Custom GUIs, Fonts, UIs
> Capitalized Fonts, Dark Mode Containers, Recolourful HUD
> 
> These are lighter GPU-wise but demand consistency and can affect performance with overlays.


> ## Final Pick Recommendations
> Resolution	Goal	GPU Recommendation
> 1080p	60–90 FPS + Iris	RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT
> 1440p	High FPS + Ultra shaders	RTX 4070 / RX 7800 XT
> 1080p	Budget + QoL mods only	GTX 1660 Super / RX 6600
